eps.d: Banished to Britland, Mr.Majeika is forced to become a teacher. On his very first day, he accidentally turns Hamish Bigmore into a frog. His two best pupils find out his secret but promise to keep it safe. Hamish becomes a boy once again.

It is fete time at the school and Mr.Majeika is an enthusiastic convert to everything to do with the festivities. He becomes obsessed with winning the trophy for best contributor to the day. Needless to say much chaos and mayhem ensue.

Mr.Potter's lonely hearts letter finds its way to Wolpurgia where the besotted Wilhermina assumes it is addressed to her from her former amour Mr.Majeika. She descends to Britland on a black balloon to offer herself to him. He is horrified

An evening of music is arranged for the parents with centre stage taken by Hamish Bigmore of course, since his father is a rich benefactor of the college. Mr.Majeika sees a chance to finally rid himself of his Wilhomena by mailing her back

The pupils are cycling to the local woods for a scouting adventure. Hamish Bigmore hates being poured into his cub scout uniform and makes a nuisance of himself as usual. Everyone else enjoys the trip to the haunted Wailing Wood. Ghostly.
It's the end of term and Mr Majeika has an opportunity to return to the wizarding world of Walpurgis.
